title: System Card: Claude Opus 4.6 (anthropic, 2026-02-05)
abstract: [anthropic-claude-opus-4-6-system-card] Recently, we discovered and disrupted a case of cybercriminals​ ​using “​vibe hacking​” to carry out extortion attempts​​with the help of models; we also​ ​discovered and disrupted​​GTG-1002​, which we assess​​was a state-sponsored​ ​cyberespionage campaign in part automated by AI.
